newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ 98-day T-bills yield 8.263 pct at tender.
newsitem.headline: NZ 98-day T-bills yield 8.263 pct at tender.

text.p: The weighted average yield for NZ$75 million of 98-day treasury bills at Tuesday's tender was 8.263 percent versus 8.486 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender, the Reserve Bank said.

The weighted average yield for NZ$75 million of 196-day treasury bills was 8.030 percent versus 7.995 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender. A single bidder was accepted and bids totalled $251 million.
The weighted average yield for the NZ$50 million of 413-day treasury bills was 7.863 percent versus 7.72 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender.
